status: prepared - not started (production needs owner approval)
variable: form of the spoken first line (also the on-screen hook text): declarative statement vs direct question

arms.statement: First line is a declarative claim (misconception reversal or surprising claim), 5-9 words, no question mark, no 'you won't believe'.
arms.question: First line is a direct Why/How question about the topic, 5-11 words, ending with '?'.

hypothesis: A declarative first line keeps more viewers past the opening than a direct question (audit 2026-10-16: question openers 20-41% kept watching vs 29-52% for statements, n=2 vs 6 - suggestive only).
primary_metric: stayed_to_watch (YouTube Studio 'viewed vs swiped away'), measured at the same video age for every video
primary_metric_fallback: engaged_view_rate = engagedViews / views (YouTube Analytics API). Chosen once for the whole experiment: Studio if it is available for all 12 videos, otherwise the API proxy for all 12 - never mixed.
secondary_metrics: retention at ~12% of the video (about 3 s)

measurement_window.rule: each video measured at publish + 7 days (own date filter); a video measured earlier or later is reported separately, not pooled

decision_rule.statement_better: statement ahead in >= 5 of 6 pairs AND median paired difference >= +5 pp on the primary metric AND guardrail median difference >= -5 pp
decision_rule.question_better: the same rule with the arms swapped
decision_rule.otherwise: inconclusive - no change to the factory default
decision_rule.uncertainty: 6 pairs is a small sample: 6/6 wins is a one-sided sign test p ~ 0.016, 5/6 p ~ 0.11. A result is directional evidence for the next default, not statistical certainty; topic effects can still dominate.

held_constant: frame 0: the same planned visual for the topic whatever the arm (subject >= 35% of height, inside the safe margin)
length 20-25 s; same voice, caption style, music and doodle engine
post-hook structure: the factory's normal structure - NO planned second surprise in 3-9 s (that is the beat3to9 experiment's variable)
one pair published per day, 18:00 and 23:00 Europe/Rome, the arm in the 18:00 slot alternating between pairs
title and thumbnail: normal package selection; title form (question/statement) recorded as a covariate
production_rules: factory.py init --count 1 per topic with --constraint 'H1 arm=<arm>: first spoken line = <opening_line>'
the HOOK stage selects a candidate whose spoken_text is the planned opening line (minor wording fixes allowed only if the RESEARCH gate needs them; record any change)
every claim must pass the RESEARCH gate; if a planned statement is not supported, reword it and record the revision before production
no new topics mid-experiment; a failed topic is replaced only by a pre-registered spare in the same category
separation_from_beat3to9: EXP-2026W42-beat3to9-c, its batch, slots, runs and input spec are not touched and not reused
H1 videos are not produced with experiment.py and never placed in that batch
H1 publishing starts only after the beat3to9 videos have been published, or on days/slots that experiment does not use

pilot_observations.note: Finished before H1 was designed (arms not assigned in advance, topics not matched): tracked, EXCLUDED from the decision rule.
